title: Governed Record Schema
description: Reasoning Fabric connector. A published version of a Metamodel record, as the Fabric returns it to applications: the record itself, its verification state and confidence, the approver, and the provenance trail behind it. Applications show the record, its source link, tier and last-verified date together, and cite the provenance reference.

governedRecordID.description: Identifier of this version: the entity ID, '@' and the version, e.g. OBL-AU-CPS230-48@2

entityID.description: Identifier of the record within its domain

dataset.description: Governed dataset the record belongs to

publicationStatus.description: published = approved or reverified; unverified = published automatically and not yet reviewed (leads and commentary); pendingReview = visible to reviewers only; superseded = replaced by a later version; removed = withdrawn from publication

record.description: The Metamodel record, valid against the schema for domainType

metamodelVersion.description: Version of the Metamodel the record was validated against

approval.description: The named person who approved this version, when approval was required

lastVerified.description: Date last checked against the official text

freshnessThreshold.description: Maximum age before the record is stale, as an ISO 8601 duration

stale.description: Whether the record is past its freshness threshold

provenanceRecordIDs.description: Provenance entries behind this version, oldest first
